llms.body:
# Domestika

> Domestika is the largest creative community. Learn and share from anywhere with online courses taught by top professionals in the world of design and creativity. This file links to Markdown versions of the site optimized for LLMs.

- [Full course catalog](https://www.domestika.org/llms-full.txt): Top courses of every category, all in one file.

Every page linked below has a Markdown version at the same address with `.md` appended,
and so does every course: a course page at `/{language}/courses/{id}-{slug}` answers at
`/{language}/courses/{id}-{slug}.md` with its description, who it is for, its final
project, its requirements and its lesson outline. There are too many course pages to
list here, so follow the listings below to find them.

The blog follows the same convention: an article at `/{language}/blog/{id}-{slug}`
answers at `/{language}/blog/{id}-{slug}.md` with its text, images and tags. Start
from the blog index at `/{language}/blog` to find the articles.

## Domestika Plus

Domestika Plus is a subscription, paid monthly or yearly, that renews automatically until it is cancelled. When a first-year promotion is running, the first year of the yearly plan costs less, and the subscription then renews at the standard yearly price. Prices depend on the currency of the visitor and on the promotions running, so the Plus page in each language below states the current ones. Help Center: [How is Domestika Plus renewed?](https://support.domestika.org/hc/en-us/articles/4417450790161-How-is-Domestika-Plus-renewed), [How to stop Domestika Plus from renewing](https://support.domestika.org/hc/en-us/articles/4417474796817-I-don-t-want-to-renew-my-Domestika-Plus-how-can-I-do-this) and [Can I get a refund for Domestika Plus?](https://support.domestika.org/hc/en-us/articles/23641984541457-Can-I-get-a-refund-for-Domestika-Plus).

## Español

- [Categorías de cursos](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/category.md): Todas las categorías de cursos de Domestika. Cada enlace apunta a una lista en Markdown de los cursos de esa categoría.
- [Cursos por área](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/area.md): Cursos de Domestika organizados por área de aplicación. Cada enlace apunta a una lista en Markdown de los cursos de esa área.
- [Cursos por software](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/software.md): Cursos de Domestika organizados por el software que enseñan. Cada enlace apunta a una lista en Markdown de los cursos de ese software.
- [Domestika Plus](https://www.domestika.org/es/plus): La página de la suscripción Domestika Plus, con sus precios y condiciones actuales.

## English

- [Course categories](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/category.md): All Domestika course categories. Each link points to a Markdown list of the courses in that category.
- [Courses by area](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area.md): Domestika courses organized by area of application. Each link points to a Markdown list of the courses in that area.
- [Courses by software](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/software.md): Domestika courses organized by the software they teach. Each link points to a Markdown list of the courses for that software.
- [Guides and comparisons](https://www.domestika.org/en/reports.md): Guides to learning a creative discipline and comparisons to help choose where, written by the Domestika team. The link points to a Markdown list of them, and each one is in Markdown too.
- [Domestika Plus](https://www.domestika.org/en/plus): The Domestika Plus subscription page, with its current prices and terms.

# Domestika

> Domestika is the largest creative community. Learn and share from anywhere with online courses taught by top professionals in the world of design and creativity. This file contains the top courses of every category. Full per-category listings: see https://www.domestika.org/llms.txt.

## Cursos (Español)

### [Cursos online de Escritura](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/category/18-escritura.md)

- [Escritura de una novela paso a paso](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/2264-escritura-de-una-novela-paso-a-paso): Cristina López Barrio — Aprende las claves para crear una novela y estimula tu imaginación con ejercicios prácticos para conectar con tu mundo interior
- [Copywriting para redes sociales](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/1620-copywriting-para-redes-sociales): Paul Anglin — Aprende a redactar textos eficaces para atraer e impactar a la audiencia de tu marca
- [Escritura creativa para principiantes: da vida a tu historia](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/1779-escritura-creativa-para-principiantes-da-vida-a-tu-historia): Shaun Levin — Aprende a dibujar con palabras y usa los detalles de tu imaginación para escribir una historia memorable.
- [Gimnasio de escritura: de la hoja en blanco a la práctica cotidiana](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/3414-gimnasio-de-escritura-de-la-hoja-en-blanco-a-la-practica-cotidiana): Aniko Villalba — Entrena la escritura creativa hasta convertirla en un hábito a partir de ejercicios de documentación y generación de ideas
- [Introducción a la escritura narrativa](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/1020-introduccion-a-la-escritura-narrativa): Alberto Chimal — Aprende paso a paso todo lo esencial para comenzar a escribir historias memorables
- [Ilustración y escritura de un libro infantil](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/1733-ilustracion-y-escritura-de-un-libro-infantil): Valentina Toro — Descubre el mundo de los libros ilustrados y aprende a contar historias a través del texto y la imagen
- [Introducción al storytelling personal](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/660-introduccion-al-storytelling-personal): Antonio Nunez Lopez — Aprende a captar la atención de tus clientes y a cautivarlos mediante el uso del relato
- [Escritura de guion para cine y televisión](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/554-escritura-de-guion-para-cine-y-television): Julio Rojas — Descubre un método creativo para empezar a contar tus historias audiovisuales
- [Relato corto de ficción: escribe desde tu experiencia personal](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/2239-relato-corto-de-ficcion-escribe-desde-tu-experiencia-personal): Shaun Levin — Aprende a escribir historias que cautiven a tus lectores construyendo una narrativa con elementos de ficción
- [Storytelling para freelance y creadores](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/2638-storytelling-para-freelance-y-creadores): Sun Yi — Desarrolla la historia detrás de tu marca personal y aprende a vender tus ideas explorando técnicas narrativas que conecten con tu audiencia
- [Técnicas narrativas para libros infantiles](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/495-tecnicas-narrativas-para-libros-infantiles): Natalia Méndez — Aprende los elementos básicos de un relato para crear historias para niños
- [Creación de cuentos infantiles](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/2178-creacion-de-cuentos-infantiles): Ilan Brenman — Deleita a los pequeños grandes lectores con historias inspiradas en su día a día y despierta al escritor que llevas dentro
- [Técnicas de storytelling para transmitir tu mensaje](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/2295-tecnicas-de-storytelling-para-transmitir-tu-mensaje): Gabriel García de Oro — Descubre la herramienta más potente para comunicar tu marca, tu negocio o tu trabajo de manera efectiva y a través de las emociones
- [Introducción a la escritura fantástica y de ciencia ficción](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/2251-introduccion-a-la-escritura-fantastica-y-de-ciencia-ficcion): Andrea Chapela — Descubre cómo desarrollar una idea y construir universos literarios con estructuras y técnicas, que conecten con tus lectores
- [Copywriting: define el tono de tu marca personal](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/151-copywriting-define-el-tono-de-tu-marca-personal): Carla Gonzalez — Aprende a construir una personalidad de marca sólida y coherente
- [Diario de poesía visual: narra con fotografía y versos](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/4040-diario-de-poesia-visual-narra-con-fotografia-y-versos): Lina Botero — Aprende a narrar combinando distintos lenguajes como la palabra, el video y la fotografía para plasmar tus emociones de forma original.
- [Copywriting: principios de la redacción publicitaria](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/1731-copywriting-principios-de-la-redaccion-publicitaria): Erica Igue — Aprende técnicas para traducir tus ideas en palabras y crea textos potentes para diferentes formatos
- [Psicología de personajes en relatos](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/2684-psicologia-de-personajes-en-relatos): Cecilia Magaña Chávez — Aprende a dar vida a personajes ficticios a partir de recursos psicológicos de escritura para narrar historias en los medios de tu elección
- [Escritura de memorias: una historia personal para una audiencia universal](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/2658-escritura-de-memorias-una-historia-personal-para-una-audiencia-universal): Courtney Maum — Aprende a escribir una narrativa personal convincente explorando diferentes posibilidades y estructuras literarias
- [Escritura de libros para principiantes: desarrolla tus ideas en papel](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/2675-escritura-de-libros-para-principiantes-desarrolla-tus-ideas-en-papel): Shaun Levin — Convierte tus ideas escritas en un proyecto de libro factible explorando tu curiosidad, imaginación y visión del mundo.

### [Cursos online de Música y Audio](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/category/19-musica-y-audio.md)

- [Introducción a la producción musical](https://www.domestika.org/es/courses/2419-introduccion-a-la-produccion-musical): Nicolas Astegiano — Aprende a crear digitalmente una pieza musical completa, pasando por la composición, edición de audio, mezcla y másteres

For the creation of these designs I have mainly used stock photos and icons, except for some created specifically for the creativity. All the themes of the creativities represent different concepts from a dreamlike point of view, revolving around the creative world, the designer or represent from illustration to marketing, being the starting point of the main categories of Domestika.","SAMPLE_PROJECT_STEP_1":"Step 1: Planning & Sketching","SAMPLE_PROJECT_STEP_1_DESCRIPTION":"Initial Planning & Sketching begins with opening Photoshop and creating a new canvas with adequate dimensions for the digital collage. At this stage, the focus is on developing a rough composition that captures the dreamlike essence of the concept, using basic shapes and placeholder elements to map out where the main visual components will be positioned.\n\nThe sketching process involves creating separate layers for different elements, ensuring flexibility for later adjustments. This preliminary phase is crucial for establishing visual hierarchy, flow and composition, helping to determine how stock photos, icons, and custom elements will interact to convey the intended creative message while maintaining Domestika's artistic direction.","SAMPLE_PROJECT_STEP_2":"Step 2: Adding elements to the design","SAMPLE_PROJECT_STEP_2_DESCRIPTION":"Adding elements to the design starts with importing the selected stock photos and vectors that will serve as the foundation for the collage. During this stage, maintain proper organization by naming layers descriptively and grouping related elements together, making adjustments to scale and positioning to achieve the intended visual impact while preserving the dreamlike quality envisioned in the sketch.","SAMPLE_PROJECT_STEP_3":"Step 3: Final art","SAMPLE_PROJECT_STEP_3_DESCRIPTION":"The final art involves refining and polishing the composition through color grading, lighting effects, and texture overlays to enhance the dreamlike atmosphere. <p class="dropdown-menu--mega__blog-post__desc">
From expressive watercolor and imaginative illustration to floral embroidery and creative coding, discover ten courses that could inspire your next project.

Sometimes, trying a different technique is all it takes to get your ideas moving again. You might swap your screen for a sketchbook, discover how to build images with code, or turn natural materials into something unexpected.

This selection brings together ten Domestika courses taught by creatives based in the UK, spanning design, illustration, photography, animation, and craft. Whether you want to develop an existing skill or explore unfamiliar territory, there’s plenty here to spark your curiosity.

1. Creative Watercolor Sketching for Beginners — Laura McKendry

A sketchbook can be a place to experiment without needing every page to become a finished artwork. In this course, Laura McKendry introduces a playful approach to watercolor sketching, encouraging you to explore the medium and discover different ways to express your ideas.

Choose this course if you want to loosen up your drawing practice, explore watercolor, and give yourself more room to experiment.

<p class="dropdown-menu--mega__blog-post__desc">
From expressive watercolor and imaginative illustration to floral embroidery and creative coding, discover ten courses that could inspire your next project.

Sometimes, trying a different technique is all it takes to get your ideas moving again. You might swap your screen for a sketchbook, discover how to build images with code, or turn natural materials into something unexpected.

This selection brings together ten Domestika courses taught by creatives based in the UK, spanning design, illustration, photography, animation, and craft. Whether you want to develop an existing skill or explore unfamiliar territory, there’s plenty here to spark your curiosity.

1. Creative Watercolor Sketching for Beginners — Laura McKendry

A sketchbook can be a place to experiment without needing every page to become a finished artwork. In this course, Laura McKendry introduces a playful approach to watercolor sketching, encouraging you to explore the medium and discover different ways to express your ideas.

Choose this course if you want to loosen up your drawing practice, explore watercolor, and give yourself more room to experiment.
